item.title: HIGHLIGHTS: No. 25 Midland takes down the defending national champions to remain perfect
item.description: MIDLAND, Texas (KMID/KPEJ) - No. 25 Midland defeated No. 1 Salt Lake Community College 19-9, improving to 7-0 on the season. The Chaps have now outscored their opponents 110-39.
